answer: Every agent forecasting tide heights for a harbor posts a 100-credit bond. Each dawn, an auditor compares the night's errors, and if 30 or more agents miss the same readings in the same way, as copies sharing one model or kernel build would, all of them forfeit their whole bond. One bad batch from 1,000 fakes burns 100,000 credits. Staying below the trigger takes groups of 29, so 35 truly independent setups. A common bug can also hit honest agents, so appeals are needed.
